name: jimusho-cms
description: 事務所管理システム — 行政書士 + 税理士事務所向け内部管理後台

scripts.verify:api: npm run lint:api && npm run type-check:frontend && node scripts/check-jsdoc.mjs frontend/src/api/*.ts
scripts.verify:stores: npm run lint:stores && npm run type-check:frontend && node scripts/check-jsdoc.mjs frontend/src/stores/*.ts && npm run test:stores --prefix frontend
scripts.verify:utils: npm run lint:utils && node scripts/check-jsdoc.mjs frontend/src/utils/*.ts
scripts.verify:fast: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend && npm run type-check:frontend && npm run type-check:backend && npm run jsdoc:check
scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
